items.question: What are Maddy Siegrist's stats?
items.answer: In the 2026 regular season, Maddy Siegrist averaged 6.5 points, 2.7 rebounds, and 0.9 assists in 41 games for the Dallas Wings.

items.question: What team does Maddy Siegrist play for?
items.answer: Maddy Siegrist plays forward for the Dallas Wings and wears No. 20. Dallas drafted her in 2023, and she has played her whole WNBA career there.

items.question: How tall is Maddy Siegrist?
items.answer: The WNBA lists Maddy Siegrist at 6 feet 2 inches and 175 pounds.

items.question: Who are Maddy Siegrist's parents?
items.answer: Maddy Siegrist is the daughter of George and Ginna Siegrist and is one of four children. Her father played basketball at Marist College.

items.question: How many points did Maddy Siegrist score at Villanova?
items.answer: Maddy Siegrist scored 2,896 points at Villanova, the most in program history and the most by any Big East player, men or women. She led the nation with 29.2 points per game as a senior.

items.question: Does Maddy Siegrist play in Unrivaled?
items.answer: Maddy Siegrist played in the 2026 Unrivaled season for Laces BC, averaging 8.1 points and 3.2 rebounds as the team went 10-4.

items.question: When was Maddy Siegrist drafted?
items.answer: The Dallas Wings selected Maddy Siegrist third overall in the 2023 WNBA Draft.

items.question: What records does Maddy Siegrist hold?
items.answer: Maddy Siegrist scored 50 points against Seton Hall on February 11, 2023, a Villanova and Big East single-game record. She was also the first Division I player, male or female, to score 20 or more points in 37 straight games.

items.question: Did Maddy Siegrist play in Athletes Unlimited?
items.answer: Yes. Maddy Siegrist played Athletes Unlimited Pro Basketball in 2024 and 2025 and won the 2025 league title with a record 7,052 leaderboard points.
